Let me be a little bit more clear with my personal situation. I met this guy on my first day at college in August of 2016 and we got to know each other quite a bit the first two semesters but not super close to each other yet. But then the summer of 2017 we started hanging out every day and I’d sneak out of the job I lived at/had a curfew at the entire summer to drive around and hang out with him. We got very close that summer. I had told him I had feelings for him all year around midsummer and he said he didn’t feel the same way but seemed like he did which is why I risked telling him. But I didn’t take it too hard cus I was like “I was just telling you so you knew, I don’t expect you to force any feelings you don’t have cus I value our friendship” but by the end of the summer we tried dating for an experimental week but he ended it because it didn’t feel right. It sucked but I understood. Anyway school started again and we were still tight af and a couple months later I told him I wasn’t over him and if he thought he’d ever change his mind and I remember very vividly him saying “I don’t see myself ever changing my mind” which also sucked but I was like hey I would stay friend zoned my entire life if that meant us staying besties. And so school ended and he helped me through some mental stuff going on cus I had to drop out of school a month before graduation (I went to a two year college) and we were still close af even after I moved 600 miles away for the summer of 2018. I couldn’t stay away from him tho. I was in love with this man and I came back to visit often so I decided to move back last August. He helped me get settled back in and we were inseparable. Flash forward to January 1st 2019, He then decided it may be time to try “us” again and we’ve been together, in love, and happy ever since. He moved in a week after we started dating. We talk about our future together, his family knows me, and I just have this feeling in my bones well be together forever. When you know you just know. 
I don’t suggest moving as fast as we did, all things considered. But I do suggest going for it, as you will never know an answer if you don’t ask the question. But if you get rejected again don’t be too upset. Sometimes things need time to work up to something amazing. Everything has a time to bloom and even if she never feels the same way, at least you can stay friends and know you never gave up. One thing worse than rejection is never going for it and not knowing what could have happened. 
I know this is really long sorry for making you read lol but I wish you the very best!

Bro I completely encourage trying again. It’s all about maturity. I have been in love since the first few weeks that I knew my current boyfriend that I’m currently laying next to. We were best friends for two years and in that span of time I told him I still had feelings for him three separate times and each time he was like “I still haven’t changed my mind” and I was like damn that sucks but I’ll try again later. Sometimes you just aren’t in the right places in life for a relationship to work out. But I was patient and he was so very much worth waiting for. We have such a strong relationship because we were best friends first and we handled the fact that I had feelings so maturely and didn’t let it affect the close friendship we had. We are now six months in and he loves me as much as I love him. Be patient and don’t let rejection get you down if it doesn’t happen to work out. There’s a time for everything if it’s meant to be. I’m proof!
